original_source_method: All 849 original features of five complete families and every retained Natural Earth country polygon tested with Shapely covered_by at authenticated native centres. Original geometry, no repair/buffer. Cohort holds apply to whole current-location owner across both packages. Country absence alone is not a veto.
original_disposition_limits: Qualified means bounded additive source-fit eligibility to existing owner, subject to separate current-owner-zero and physical witness validation; it is not new regional semantic approval or proof of a repaired delivery.
All 24880 source-relative cells remain physical-interpretation holds: original source coverage alone does not distinguish river, coast, ocean or vintage mismatch. No blanket ocean inference.
Hoang Sa and Truong Sa are explicitly held as disputed-territory research regardless of positive source coverage. Natural Earth is a retained display convention, not a sovereignty adjudication.
All direct conflict flags hold the complete current-location owner cohort in both packages. Other cells of that cohort are not independently asserted wrong.
VNM ADM2 represented-year claim 2020 and ADM1 2008 are retained source claims, not independently verified current administrative boundaries.
Existing source review and aggregate-member semantic questions remain open, including Da Nang. The seven source atoms authenticate existing lineage only.

custodian_chronology.scope: Native row dates and later workbook/catalogue timestamps are distinct. Null VALIDTO does not independently prove continued legal validity. Not the absent108965-byte2020XLSX.
